comment: Golden vectors for the model identity <-> name token escape.
This file is the cross-repo contract between tt-shield (which builds artifact
and CI job names) and tt-inference-server (which parses them back). The same
file lives at .github/scripts/model_naming_vectors.json in tt-shield and at
each repo asserts its own implementation against its own copy.
Pinning the format with data rather than sharing code is deliberate: the
escape is one line, while sharing the code would mean one repo fetching and
executing the other's module at CI time. A drift then fails on the pull
request that introduced it, in the repo that introduced it.
Adding a vector: add it to both copies in the same change. Every entry must

escape.why: a single underscore in the name, which is why the escape is __ and not _
a single underscore next to digits; must not be confused with the escape
bare id that already contains an underscore; unchanged in both directions
org-less Forge CNN id; passes through untouched
dots and hyphens on both sides of the separator
mixed case is significant: HF repo ids are case-sensitive
differs from google/gemma-4-31b-it only by case; both are distinct ids
see above -- collapsing the two would merge two different models
a long name ending in a version, as media models do
